= link-formatting-subs(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-10-05
:source-highlighter: rouge
:acdc-index:

== Name
link-formatting-subs - control formatting at link boundaries

== Description

[source,text,subs="+quotes,+macros"]
----
S01 *Before https://outer.example[Before *bold mailto:inner@example.org[Inner] tail* after] end*.
S02 _Before https://example.org/italic[_Italic_ after] end_.
S03 *Before https://example.org/note[*Note footnote:code[Code note.] ((Code term))* after] end*.
----

[source,text,subs="+quotes"]
----
S04 *Before https://example.org/disabled[*Literal* after] end*.
----

[source,text,subs="+macros"]
----
S05 *Before https://example.org/quotes-off[*Literal* after] end*.
----

[subs="none"]
S06 *Before https://example.org/none[*Literal* after] end*.

[subs="quotes"]
S07 *Before https://example.org/only-quotes[*Literal* after] end*.

[subs="macros,quotes"]
S08 *Before https://example.org/reordered[*Bold* after] end*.

S09 pass:q,m[*Before https://example.org/pass[*Bold* after] end*].

S10 *Before https://example.org/profile[pass:q[*Bold*] after] end*.

After *normal* text and footnote:code[].
